paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices. Each slice represents a specific data source with distinct labels, colors, and percentage values: NQ (blue, 31.3%), FEVER (teal, 16.1%), SNLI (light orange, 15.4%), VITAMINC (aquamarine, 13.0%), MULTINLI (rose, 11.3%), ANLI (orange, 4.6%), FACTCC (green, 2.6%), ENTFA (gold, 1.8%), XSUMHUL (light blue, 1.6%), SCITAIL (light green, 1.2%), MULTIFC (light blue, 0.5%), PUBHEALTH (light green, 0.5%), and SCIFACT (light blue, 0.1%). There is no legend explaining the colors corresponding to each slice, and percentages are labeled outside the slices, beneath the segment labels.
